connect.title: Connect Your Rachio Account
connect.description:
This integration talks to the Rachio cloud API to read your controllers and zones, so it can pre-fill most of setup for you and keep zone runtimes current.

Enter your Rachio API key. It is checked with Rachio before you continue.

data_description.api_key: Get it in the Rachio web app (app.rach.io): Account Settings → Get API Key.

bindings.title: Core Setup
bindings.description: Point the scheduler at your notification, calendar, Rachio controller, and forecast entities.

data_description.rachio_device_name: Your Rachio controller. Auto-listed from your account when the API key resolves; otherwise type the exact device name (Rachio app → Settings → Devices).
data_description.standby_switch: Your Rachio controller's standby switch; the scheduler mirrors it to suspend watering.
data_description.forecast_entity: A weather.* entity providing an hourly forecast (used for rain-skip and overnight forecast means).
data_description.notify_service: Pick a notify SERVICE the scheduler can call directly, e.g. one starting notify.mobile_app_. A plain notify entity won't work — the scheduler calls notify services by name, not the send_message entity API.
data_description.calendar_entity: The calendar the scheduler adds each night's watering summary to.

weather.title: Weather Station
weather.description: Your local weather-station sensors, plus the sensor-name prefixes for hourly precipitation forecasts.

data_description.precipitation_chance_prefix: Prefix of your hourly forecast precip-chance sensors; the scheduler appends an hour count, e.g. sensor.precipitation_chance_3_hour.
data_description.precipitation_amount_prefix: Prefix of your hourly forecast precip-amount sensors; the scheduler appends an hour count, e.g. sensor.precipitation_amount_3_hour.
data_description.weather_temperature: Outdoor temperature from your weather station, in any unit; warm nights lengthen the disease window.
data_description.weather_humidity: Outdoor relative humidity (%); humid nights shorten the watering window to limit disease.
data_description.weather_wind: Wind speed in any unit, ideally an average; still air counts toward disease risk.
data_description.weather_rain_last_hour: The rain gauge's total for the past hour (mm or inches). Rain stops a run, and the gauge confirms rain while a spray zone runs.
data_description.weather_precip_type: The station's precipitation type; rain or hail stops a run.
data_description.weather_rain_today: The rain gauge's total since midnight (mm or inches); a night with real rain is left out of watering calibration.

zone.title: Add a Zone
zone.description: Pick a Rachio zone to auto-fill its runtime and refill depth, or enter one manually.

data.add_another_zone: Add another zone after this one

data_description.key: A short identifier for this zone, e.g. front_lawn. Used as the zone's config key and shown in logs.
data_description.target_range: The GeoDrops moisture band the scheduler keeps this zone at.
data_description.geography: A free-text label to group zones for your own organization (e.g. front, back). Not used by the scheduler's logic.
data_description.adjacency: Other zones physically next to this one; the scheduler avoids watering neighbors back-to-back to limit runoff.
data_description.runtime_minutes: Minutes for a full refill of this zone — use the Rachio app's computed zone runtime.
data_description.refill_depth_mm: Full-refill depth in mm — Rachio's depthOfWater (inches) × 25.4.
data_description.spray: Enable if this zone's spray can reach your weather station. The scheduler then confirms 'rain' with the physical rain gauge instead of trusting the reported precipitation type while this zone is running.
data_description.rachio_zone: Pick your zone from the live list pulled from Rachio — its runtime and refill depth are pre-filled on the next screen. Choose "Enter manually" for a zone that isn't in Rachio.
data_description.rachio_switch: The Home Assistant switch that turns this zone's water on (from the Rachio integration).
data_description.dominant_sensor: The GeoDrops sensor for this zone's dominant soil-moisture reading (the value the scheduler waters toward).
data_description.state_sensor: The GeoDrops sensor reporting this zone's moisture state/health.
data_description.quality_sensors: One or more GeoDrops quality/telemetry sensors for this zone (used to validate readings).
data_description.add_another_zone: Set up another zone next, before finishing.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Active Watering Calibration is Beta and off by default.

data_description.self_calibration_enabled: When on, each zone learns its own dosing from soil-moisture response. Beta — leave off until you've watched it run.
data_description.advanced_overrides: Optional YAML mapping merged into tunables for advanced tuning. Leave blank unless you know what you're changing.

zone_details.title: Set Up This Zone
zone_details.description: You picked a Rachio zone — now link it to the Home Assistant entities that track and control it. **Full-refill runtime and depth are pre-filled from Rachio**; change them only if you have better numbers.

data.add_another_zone: Add another zone after this one

data_description.key: A short identifier for this zone, e.g. front_lawn. Used as the zone's config key and shown in logs. Pre-filled from the Rachio zone name — edit if you like.
data_description.rachio_switch: The Home Assistant switch that turns THIS zone's water on (created by the Rachio integration, e.g. switch.front_yard). We pre-fill it with the switch whose name matches the Rachio zone you picked — confirm it's correct and change it if the guess is wrong. It's separate from the Rachio zone itself: the zone gave us calibration data, but the scheduler needs this HA switch to actually run watering.
data_description.dominant_sensor: The GeoDrops sensor for this zone's dominant soil-moisture reading (the value the scheduler waters toward).
data_description.state_sensor: The GeoDrops sensor reporting this zone's moisture state/health.
data_description.quality_sensors: One or more GeoDrops quality/telemetry sensors for this zone (used to validate readings).
data_description.target_range: The GeoDrops moisture band the scheduler keeps this zone at.
data_description.geography: Optional free-text group label to organize zones your way (e.g. "front", "back"). Purely cosmetic — the scheduler's logic ignores it.
data_description.adjacency: Optional. Other zones physically next to this one. The scheduler avoids watering neighbors back-to-back to limit runoff and pressure drop.
data_description.runtime_minutes: Minutes for a full refill — pre-filled from Rachio's computed zone runtime when available.
data_description.refill_depth_mm: Full-refill depth in mm — pre-filled from Rachio's depthOfWater (inches × 25.4) when available.
data_description.spray: Turn on ONLY if this zone's spray physically reaches your weather station. When it does, the scheduler double-checks 'rain' against the real rain gauge while this zone runs, so its own spray isn't mistaken for rainfall. Leave off for drip or zones far from the station.
data_description.add_another_zone: Set up another zone next, before finishing.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Your Rachio API Key
reauth_confirm.description: Rachio rejected the API key this integration has, or it has none yet. Watering continues on the zones' stored runtimes; enter a current key so they stay up to date.

data_description.api_key: Get it in the Rachio web app (app.rach.io): Account Settings → Get API Key.

reconfigure.title: Replace Your Rachio API Key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key for the same Rachio account, for example after regenerating it. Zones, sensors and other settings are changed under Configure.

data_description.api_key: Get it in the Rachio web app (app.rach.io): Account Settings → Get API Key.

error.invalid_notify_service: That target can't be called as a notify service. Pick a notify.mobile_app_* (or similar) service, not a notify entity.
error.duplicate_zone_key: A zone with this name already exists. Choose a different zone name.
error.invalid_auth: Rachio rejected this API key. Check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Rachio. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.wrong_account: This API key belongs to a different Rachio account than the one this integration is set up with.

missing_entities.title: Entities used by {title} are missing
missing_entities.description:
These entities, picked when {title} was set up, no longer exist: {entities}.

The scheduler reads a missing entity as off or as no reading, so a zone whose valve switch or moisture sensor is missing will not be watered.

If you renamed one, it is followed automatically; this means it was deleted or its integration was removed. Go to **Settings → Devices & services → GeoDrops + Rachio Irrigation → Configure** and pick a replacement, or restore the entity. This notice clears once nothing is missing.
